# OptiMonk

> OptiMonk is an agentic popup builder for ecommerce stores. You describe the popup you want in one sentence, and the AI agent designs it for your brand, writes the copy, builds a separate mobile version and sets the targeting. You review it and switch it on.

Key facts:

- Formats: standard popups, fullscreen popups, lucky wheels and scratch cards. No templates: the agent designs each popup from your site's colors, fonts and logo. The Popup Library is inspiration.
- Targeting: exit intent on desktop and mobile, time delay, scroll depth, on click, inactivity, pages, traffic source, country, returning visitors, subscribers, cart value and cart contents, Klaviyo lists and segments.
- Testing: A/B test copy, offers or whole designs, with a holdout group that sees no popup. The agent suggests test ideas.
- Ecommerce: Shopify app with unique and auto-applied discount codes; also WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, Wix, Squarespace and any site via a JavaScript snippet or Google Tag Manager.
- Integrations: Klaviyo, Mailchimp, HubSpot, Omnisend, Attentive, Postscript and 30+ more email, SMS and CRM tools. OptiMonk does not send email or SMS itself.
- AI assistants: connect the OptiMonk MCP server to build and edit popups from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor.
- Pricing: free plan with every feature (10,000 pageviews a month); paid plans from $19 a month billed yearly ($29 monthly).
- Company: founded in 2014; 30,000+ brands in 150+ countries.

## Product

- [Agentic popup builder](https://www.optimonk.com/agentic-popup-builder): how the AI agent designs, builds and tests popups
- [Features](https://www.optimonk.com/features): every feature, grouped by targeting, testing, ecommerce and performance
- [Pricing](https://www.optimonk.com/pricing): plans, pageview limits and AI credits
- [Integrations](https://www.optimonk.com/integrations): email, SMS, CRM and ecommerce platforms
- [Popup Library](https://www.optimonk.com/popup-library): real popups designed for real brands, by goal, season and industry
- [Changelog](https://www.optimonk.com/changelog): what's new in the product

## Use cases

- [Email popups](https://www.optimonk.com/use-cases/email-popups): grow an email and SMS list
- [Exit-intent popups](https://www.optimonk.com/use-cases/exit-intent-popups): win back visitors who are about to leave
- [Gamification](https://www.optimonk.com/use-cases/gamification): lucky wheels and scratch cards
- [Quiz popups](https://www.optimonk.com/use-cases/quiz-popups): recommend products with a few questions
- [Upsell popups](https://www.optimonk.com/use-cases/upsell-popups): raise order value
- [Seasonal offers](https://www.optimonk.com/use-cases/seasonal-offers): Black Friday, Christmas and other sales

## Comparisons

- [All comparisons](https://www.optimonk.com/compare)
- [OptiMonk vs OptinMonster](https://www.optimonk.com/optimonk-vs-optinmonster)
- [OptiMonk vs Privy](https://www.optimonk.com/optimonk-vs-privy)
- [OptiMonk vs Wisepops](https://www.optimonk.com/optimonk-vs-wisepops)
- [OptiMonk vs Justuno](https://www.optimonk.com/optimonk-vs-justuno)
- [Best Shopify popup apps](https://www.optimonk.com/best-shopify-popup-apps)
- [OptinMonster alternatives](https://www.optimonk.com/optinmonster-alternatives)
- [Privy alternatives](https://www.optimonk.com/privy-alternatives)

## Guides

- [What is OptiMonk?](https://www.optimonk.com/what-is-optimonk)
- [What is a popup window?](https://www.optimonk.com/what-is-a-pop-up-window): types, uses and whether popups hurt SEO
- [How to create an exit-intent popup](https://www.optimonk.com/how-to-create-an-exit-intent-popup)
- [Gamified popups](https://www.optimonk.com/gamified-popups): spin-to-win wheels and scratch cards
- [Popup design ideas](https://www.optimonk.com/popup-ideas): 50+ examples from online stores
- [Popup timing](https://www.optimonk.com/popup-timing): when a popup should appear
- [Modal vs popup vs overlay](https://www.optimonk.com/modal-vs-popup)
- [Shopify discount codes](https://www.optimonk.com/shopify-discount-codes)
- [Abandoned cart on Shopify](https://www.optimonk.com/abandoned-cart-shopify)
- [Case studies](https://www.optimonk.com/case-studies): results from OptiMonk customers

## Optional

- [Blog](https://www.optimonk.com/blog): all articles on popups, CRO and ecommerce marketing
- [About us](https://www.optimonk.com/about-us)
- [Contact](https://www.optimonk.com/contact-us)
- [Hungarian site](https://www.optimonk.com/hu)
- [Sitemap](https://www.optimonk.com/sitemap.xml)

  --dark:#23262A;--dark-panel:#1A1C1F;--dark-chip:#2E3237;--dark-border:#3A3E44;

    --h2-size:36px;--h2-lh:44px;
    --lead-size:18px;--lead-lh:28px;
    --section-gap:120px;
  }
}
/* ---- step 3 of 3: 1440+ ---- */
@media (min-width:1440px){
  :root{
    --container:min(1360px, 100% - 48px);
    --h1-size:64px;--h1-lh:72px;
    --h2-size:40px;--h2-lh:48px;
    --lead-size:20px;--lead-lh:30px;
    --section-gap:144px;
    --card-pad:32px;
    --composer-w:800px;
  }
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);font-family:var(--font);color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;line-height:24px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip}
main{display:block;overflow-x:clip}
img,svg{display:block}
a{color:var(--orange);text-decoration:none}
a:hover{color:var(--orange-hover)}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;margin:0;padding:0}
h1,h2,p{margin:0}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-border);outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--focus-ring);border-radius:6px}
.wrap{width:var(--container);max-width:100%;margin:0 auto;padding:0}
.blk{position:relative;padding-bottom:var(--section-gap)}
.eyebrow{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange)}
.h2{font-size:var(--h2-size);line-height:var(--h2-lh);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--ink)}
.lead{font-size:var(--lead-size);line-height:var(--lead-lh);color:var(--ink-600)}
.small{font-size:13px;line-height:20px}
.card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--r-card);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:40px;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:var(--r-btn);font-size:15px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease}
.btn-primary{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--orange-hover);color:#fff}
.btn-secondary{background:var(--gray-100);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-secondary:hover{background:var(--gray-200);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-outline{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-outline:hover{background:#FAFAFA;border-color:var(--gray-300);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-on-dark{background:var(--dark-border);color:#fff}
.btn-on-dark:hover{background:#4A4F56;color:#fff}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:34px;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:var(--r-btn);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);background:var(--white);color:var(--ink);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease;white-space:nowrap}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--gray-300);background:#FAFAFA}
.chip-static{cursor:default}
.chip-static:hover{border-color:var(--gray-200);background:var(--white)}
.motif{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;user-select:none;height:auto;z-index:0}
[data-reveal]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);transition:opacity var(--dur,.7s) var(--ease),transform var(--dur,.7s) var(--ease);transition-delay:var(--d,0ms)}
[data-reveal].is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* header */
.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;height:var(--header-h);transition:background 220ms ease,box-shadow 220ms ease,border-color 220ms ease;border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
.site-header.is-stuck{background:rgba(247,245,241,.8);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom-color:var(--gray-200)}
.site-header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:var(--header-h)}
.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
/* The panels are absolutely positioned against the header itself (the sticky header is the
   nearest positioned ancestor), so the items stay static and the panel can be centred on
   .wrap regardless of which trigger opened it. */
.nav-item{position:static;display:flex;align-items:center}
.nav-trigger{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:var(--r-btn);background:transparent;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-600);cursor:pointer;transition:background 140ms ease,color 140ms ease}
.nav-trigger:hover,.nav-item.is-open>.nav-trigger{background:var(--gray-100);color:var(--ink)}
.nav-trigger a,.nav-trigger button{color:inherit}
.nav-trigger-plain{color:var(--ink-600)}
.nav-trigger-split{padding:0}
.nav-trigger-label{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 4px 0 14px}
.nav-caret{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px 0 2px;cursor:pointer}
.nav-trigger svg{transition:transform 160ms ease}
.nav-item.is-open .nav-trigger svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.nav-burger{display:none;width:44px;height:44px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:var(--r-btn);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
.nav-burger-x{display:none}
.nav-burger[aria-expanded="true"] .nav-burger-bars{display:none}
.nav-burger[aria-expanded="true"] .nav-burger-x{display:block}
/* hero */
#hero{padding-top:72px;padding-bottom:96px}
#hero .wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;position:relative;z-index:1}
.badge{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 14px 6px 8px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-600);font-weight:500}
/* 1px light orbiting the pill: a conic gradient masked down to the border ring. */
.badge::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-1px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:1px;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;background:conic-gradient(from var(--a),transparent 0 70%,var(--peach) 82%,var(--orange) 90%,transparent 100%);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);mask-composite:exclude;animation:badgeSpin 3s linear infinite}
.badge>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
@keyframes badgeSpin{to{--a:360deg}}
.badge b{background:var(--orange-100);color:var(--orange);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
h1{font-size:var(--h1-size);line-height:var(--h1-lh);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-top:32px}
h1 .line{display:block}
/* Rotating word. The word box is left-aligned and reserves the widest word (--rot-w,
   set by JS after the webfont loads; auto until then, so the first paint is exact), and
   the whole "No <word>" line is re-centred with translateX(--rot-dx). Visually identical
   to letting the line reflow, but a transform is not a layout shift, so the typewriter
   contributes 0 to CLS. The caret is a border on an inline ::after — an inline border
   never changes the line box, so the H1 height is constant. */
.rot-line{display:inline-block;transform:translateX(var(--rot-dx,0px))}
.rot{position:relative;display:inline-block;width:var(--rot-w,auto);text-align:left;color:var(--orange);white-space:nowrap}
